description: This file defines the DoTokenParser class for Twig, a templating engine, which parses 'do' tags in templates to evaluate expressions while discarding the result.

classes.name: Twig\TokenParser\DoTokenParser
classes.description: A final class that parses 'do' tags in Twig templates to evaluate expressions without output.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'do' tag and returns a DoNode containing the evaluated expression.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string 'do' indicating the tag this parser handles.
